messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: spike in quota-enforcer DENY responses (429/409) in prod-eu-west-1. ~35% of requests denied over 4m. New deployment tag: releases/quota-enforcer:v3.1. Pager triggered: oncall-sre.
Evan (SRE-Oncall): ack. Can runtime/releases join? Any early hypothesis?
Lina (eng-runtime): joining. Logs show exemption lookup failures -> `exempt_lookup: not_found` and we treat that as DENY. Recent schema rename in v3.1 changed `exemptions.v1` -> `exemptions.active` key. Looks like canaries hit the new schema.
Omar (eng-releases): v3.1 included the new strict enforcement flag + the schema rename in the same rollout, unfortunately. Canary was 20% across a few regions. Feature flag service shows partial roll, but timeline aligns with the spike at 02:07.
Priya (product-support): getting customer reports: streaming clients getting 429s and partial billing. Support queue doubling.
Sofia (support): sample DM from tenant-105: "Started failing at 02:08, tokens deducted but no response. Can you check?" Opening support case.
Evan (SRE-Oncall): immediate plan: 1) flip strict enforcement flag off 2) enable permissive exemption fallback at runtime 3) consider rollback if not fixed in 3-5m. Omar, flip flag?
Omar (eng-releases): running: `releasesctl ff set quota_strict false --env prod` -> `OK: propagation started (est 20s)`
Lina (eng-runtime): still seeing denies but trending down. I'll set `quota.exempt_fallback=permissive` to stop missing-key -> deny behavior. Command: `rtctl set quota.exempt_fallback permissive` -> `applied on 14 nodes`.
Lina (eng-runtime): metrics after fallback: deny rate 6% -> 1.5% in last 90s. Good but need to reconcile token accounting.
deploy-bot: Incident created I-2026-0315-02 (Severity: P1)  Link: https://incidents.internal/I-2026-0315-02
Evan (SRE-Oncall): rollback recommended after we stabilize to avoid further drift. Omar, can you orchestrate rollback to v2.9.x? If rollback takes >5m we may keep the flag off and continue mitigations.
Omar (eng-releases): initiating rollback releases/quota-enforcer:v3.1 -> v2.9.9. Strategy: abort canary, parallel revert. Rolling on 12 nodes.
Lina (eng-runtime): note: some long-lived connections caused two pods to hang during restart. Forcing termination on those to speed rollback.
Omar (eng-releases): rollback complete across all nodes, now serving v2.9.9.
Lina (eng-runtime): post-rollback numbers: DENY rate ~0.4%. However, token-ledgers show ~95k tokens decremented during 02:06-02:12 window where clients received 429s.
Priya (product-support): we need list of affected tenants ASAP and rough token counts. Sofia to pull top impacted.
Sofia (support): pulling... top impacted tenants: tenant-105, tenant-301, tenant-87, tenant-412, tenant-29. I have logs: `2026-03-15T02:09:04Z tenant=tenant-301 req=xyz result=DENY token_delta=512 billing_state=consumed`.
Evan (SRE-Oncall): action items: 1) billing reconciliation ticket 2) postmortem owners: Omar (releases) + Lina (runtime) 3) support to message affected customers and offer token credits. Priya coordinate with customer success.
Omar (eng-releases): I'll own rollout/playbook follow-up. Immediate change: stop bundling schema rename + enforcement flag in same release; add compat shim and feature-flag gating to exclude schema changes during canary.
Lina (eng-runtime): runtime followups: ensure missing-key path is permissive by default, add unit/integration tests for exemption lookup, and emit metric `exempt_lookup_failures` (alert if >1% of requests).
Sofia (support): drafting customer-facing note: short timeline, mitigation, offer token credits, contact for follow-up. Will attach to incident page.
Evan (SRE-Oncall): keeping pager open until metrics stable. If token drift exceeds 200k tokens we escalate to finance for customer credit approvals.
incident-bot: Incident I-2026-0315-02 updated: State=Mitigated, Owner=Omar+Lina, Severity=P1, Links attached.
Omar (eng-releases): creating PR to revert schema rename and add backward compat layer. Also updating rollout checklist to require exemption-schema smoke tests before enabling enforcement FF.
Lina (eng-runtime): scheduling postmortem meeting with releases + support + billing. Will include timeline and reproduction steps.
Priya (product-support): closing loop for now: monitoring system for 20m. Support cases opened for impacted tenants; template includes apology and token credit proposal.
Evan (SRE-Oncall): incident moved to monitoring state after 25m stabilization. Postmortem required. Thanks all for quick turnaround!
